bio.text: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez represents New York's 14th Congressional District; she defeated incumbent Joe Crowley in the June 2018 Democratic primary and was sworn in in January 2019.
She was born in the Parkchester neighborhood of the Bronx and raised in Yorktown, New York.
She graduated from Boston University with degrees in economics and international relations, and worked as an educational director with the National Hispanic Institute before running for Congress.
